versos.hebraico: בְּ֭רִית כָּרַ֣תִּי לְעֵינָ֑י וּמָ֥ה אֶ֝תְבּוֹנֵ֗ן עַל־בְּתוּלָֽה׃

controles.web: “I made a covenant with my eyes, how then should I look lustfully at a young woman?
controles.kjv: I made a covenant with mine eyes; why then should I think upon a maid?
controles.livre: Eu fiz um pacto com meus olhos; como, pois, eu olharia com cobiça para a virgem?

versos.hebraico: וּמֶ֤ה׀ חֵ֣לֶק אֱל֣וֹהַּ מִמָּ֑עַל וְֽנַחֲלַ֥ת שַׁ֝דַּ֗י מִמְּרֹמִֽים׃

controles.web: For what is the portion from God above, and the heritage from the Almighty on high?
controles.kjv: For what portion of God is there from above? and what inheritance of the Almighty from on high?
controles.livre: Pois qual é a porção dada por Deus acima, e a herança dada pelo Todo-Poderoso das alturas?

versos.hebraico: הֲלֹא־אֵ֥יד לְעַוָּ֑ל וְ֝נֵ֗כֶר לְפֹ֣עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃

controles.web: Is it not calamity to the unrighteous, and disaster to the workers of iniquity?
controles.kjv: Is not destruction to the wicked? and a strange punishment to the workers of iniquity?
controles.livre: Por acaso a calamidade não é para o perverso, e o desastre para os que praticam injustiça?

versos.hebraico: הֲלֹא־ה֭וּא יִרְאֶ֣ה דְרָכָ֑י וְֽכָל־צְעָדַ֥י יִסְפּֽוֹר׃

controles.web: Doesn’t he see my ways, and number all my steps?
controles.kjv: Doth not he see my ways, and count all my steps?
controles.livre: Por acaso ele não vê meus caminhos, e conta todos os meus passos?

versos.hebraico: אִם־הָלַ֥כְתִּי עִם־שָׁ֑וְא וַתַּ֖חַשׁ עַל־מִרְמָ֣ה רַגְלִֽי׃

controles.web: “If I have walked with falsehood, and my foot has hurried to deceit
controles.kjv: If I have walked with vanity, or if my foot hath hasted to deceit;
controles.livre: Se eu andei com falsidade, e se meu pé se apressou para o engano,

versos.hebraico: יִשְׁקְלֵ֥נִי בְמֹאזְנֵי־צֶ֑דֶק וְיֵדַ֥ע אֱ֝ל֗וֹהַּ תֻּמָּתִֽי׃

controles.web: (let me be weighed in an even balance, that God may know my integrity);
controles.kjv: Let me be weighed in an even balance, that God may know mine integrity.
controles.livre: Pese-me ele em balanças justas, e Deus saberá minha integridade.

versos.hebraico: אִ֥ם תִּטֶּ֣ה אַשֻּׁרִי֮ מִנִּ֪י הַ֫דָּ֥רֶךְ וְאַחַ֣ר עֵ֭ינַי הָלַ֣ךְ לִבִּ֑י וּ֝בְכַפַּ֗י דָּ֣בַק מֻאֽוּם׃פ

controles.web: if my step has turned out of the way, if my heart walked after my eyes, if any defilement has stuck to my hands,
controles.kjv: If my step hath turned out of the way, and mine heart walked after mine eyes, and if any blot hath cleaved to mine hands;
controles.livre: Se meus passos se desviaram do caminho, e meu coração seguiu meus olhos, e se algo  se apegou às minhas mãos,

versos.hebraico: אֶ֭זְרְעָה וְאַחֵ֣ר יֹאכֵ֑ל וְֽצֶאֱצָאַ֥י יְשֹׁרָֽשׁוּ׃

controles.web: then let me sow, and let another eat. Yes, let the produce of my field be rooted out.
controles.kjv: Then let me sow, and let another eat; yea, let my offspring be rooted out.
controles.livre: Que eu semeie, e outro coma; e meus produtos sejam arrancados.

versos.hebraico: אִם־נִפְתָּ֣ה לִ֭בִּי עַל־אִשָּׁ֑ה וְעַל־פֶּ֖תַח רֵעִ֣י אָרָֽבְתִּי׃

controles.web: “If my heart has been enticed to a woman, and I have laid wait at my neighbor’s door,
controles.kjv: If mine heart have been deceived by a woman, or if I have laid wait at my neighbour’s door;
controles.livre: Se foi meu coração se deixou seduzir por alguma mulher, ou se estive espreitei à porta de meu próximo,

versos.hebraico: תִּטְחַ֣ן לְאַחֵ֣ר אִשְׁתִּ֑י וְ֝עָלֶ֗יהָ יִכְרְע֥וּן אֲחֵרִֽין׃

controles.web: then let my wife grind for another, and let others sleep with her.
controles.kjv: Then let my wife grind unto another, and let others bow down upon her.
controles.livre: Que minha mulher moa para outro, e outros se encurvem sobre ela.

versos.hebraico: כִּי־הוא זִמָּ֑ה והיא עָוֺ֥ן פְּלִילִֽים׃

controles.web: For that would be a heinous crime. Yes, it would be an iniquity to be punished by the judges:
controles.kjv: For this is an heinous crime; yea, it is an iniquity to be punished by the judges.
controles.livre: Pois tal seria um crime vergonhoso, e delito a ser sentenciado por juízes.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֤י אֵ֣שׁ הִ֭יא עַד־אֲבַדּ֣וֹן תֹּאכֵ֑ל וּֽבְכָל־תְּב֖וּאָתִ֣י תְשָׁרֵֽשׁ׃

controles.web: For it is a fire that consumes to destruction, and would root out all my increase.
controles.kjv: For it is a fire that consumeth to destruction, and would root out all mine increase.
controles.livre: Pois seria um fogo que consumiria até à perdição, e destruiria toda a minha renda.

versos.hebraico: אִם־אֶמְאַ֗ס מִשְׁפַּ֣ט עַ֭בְדִּי וַאֲמָתִ֑י בְּ֝רִבָ֗ם עִמָּדִֽי׃

controles.web: “If I have despised the cause of my male servant or of my female servant, when they contended with me;
controles.kjv: If I did despise the cause of my manservant or of my maidservant, when they contended with me;
controles.livre: Se desprezei o direito de meu servo ou de minha serva quando eles reclamaram comigo,

versos.hebraico: וּמָ֣ה אֶֽ֭עֱשֶׂה כִּֽי־יָק֣וּם אֵ֑ל וְכִֽי־יִ֝פְקֹ֗ד מָ֣ה אֲשִׁיבֶֽנּוּ׃

controles.web: What then shall I do when God rises up? When he visits, what shall I answer him?
controles.kjv: What then shall I do when God riseth up? and when he visiteth, what shall I answer him?
controles.livre: Que faria eu quando Deus se levantasse? E quando ele investigasse a causa ,o que eu lhe responderia?

versos.hebraico: הֲֽ֝לֹא־בַ֭בֶּטֶן עֹשֵׂ֣נִי עָשָׂ֑הוּ וַ֝יְכֻנֶ֗נּוּ בָּרֶ֥חֶם אֶחָֽד׃

controles.web: Didn’t he who made me in the womb make him? Didn’t one fashion us in the womb?
controles.kjv: Did not he that made me in the womb make him? and did not one fashion us in the womb?
controles.livre: Aquele que me fez no ventre materno também não fez a ele? E não nos preparou de um mesmo modo na madre?

versos.hebraico: אִם־אֶ֭מְנַע מֵחֵ֣פֶץ דַּלִּ֑ים וְעֵינֵ֖י אַלְמָנָ֣ה אֲכַלֶּֽה׃

controles.web: “If I have withheld the poor from their desire, or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail,
controles.kjv: If I have withheld the poor from their desire, or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail;
controles.livre: Se eu neguei aos pobres o que eles desejavam, ou fiz desfalecer os olhos da viúva;

versos.hebraico: וְאֹכַ֣ל פִּתִּ֣י לְבַדִּ֑י וְלֹא־אָכַ֖ל יָת֣וֹם מִמֶּֽנָּה׃

controles.web: or have eaten my morsel alone, and the fatherless has not eaten of it
controles.kjv: Or have eaten my morsel myself alone, and the fatherless hath not eaten thereof;
controles.livre: E se comi meu alimento sozinho, e o órfão não comeu dele

versos.hebraico: כִּ֣י מִ֭נְּעוּרַי גְּדֵלַ֣נִי כְאָ֑ב וּמִבֶּ֖טֶן אִמִּ֣י אַנְחֶֽנָּה׃

controles.web: (no, from my youth he grew up with me as with a father, her have I guided from my mother’s womb);
controles.kjv: (For from my youth he was brought up with me, as with a father, and I have guided her from my mother’s womb;)
controles.livre: (Porque desde a minha juventude cresceu comigo como se eu fosse seu pai ,e desde o ventre de minha mãe guiei a viúva );

versos.hebraico: אִם־אֶרְאֶ֣ה א֭וֹבֵד מִבְּלִ֣י לְב֑וּשׁ וְאֵ֥ין כְּ֝ס֗וּת לָאֶבְיֽוֹן׃

controles.web: if I have seen any perish for want of clothing, or that the needy had no covering;
controles.kjv: If I have seen any perish for want of clothing, or any poor without covering;
controles.livre: Se eu vi alguém morrer por falta de roupa, e o necessitado sem algo que o cobrisse,

versos.hebraico: אִם־לֹ֣א בֵרֲכ֣וּנִי חלצו וּמִגֵּ֥ז כְּ֝בָשַׂי יִתְחַמָּֽם׃

controles.web: if his heart hasn’t blessed me, if he hasn’t been warmed with my sheep’s fleece;
controles.kjv: If his loins have not blessed me, and if he were not warmed with the fleece of my sheep;
controles.livre: Se sua cintura não me bendisse, quando ele se esquentava com as peles de meus cordeiros;

versos.hebraico: אִם־הֲנִיפ֣וֹתִי עַל־יָת֣וֹם יָדִ֑י כִּֽי־אֶרְאֶ֥ה בַ֝שַּׁ֗עַר עֶזְרָתִֽי׃

controles.web: if I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless, because I saw my help in the gate,
controles.kjv: If I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless, when I saw my help in the gate:
controles.livre: Se levantei minha mão contra o órfão, quando vi que seria favorecido na corte judicial,

versos.hebraico: כְּ֭תֵפִי מִשִּׁכְמָ֣ה תִפּ֑וֹל וְ֝אֶזְרֹעִ֗י מִקָּנָ֥ה תִשָּׁבֵֽר׃

controles.web: then let my shoulder fall from the shoulder blade, and my arm be broken from the bone.
controles.kjv: Then let mine arm fall from my shoulder blade, and mine arm be broken from the bone.
controles.livre: Que minha escápula caia do meu ombro, e meu braço se quebre de sua articulação.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֤י פַ֣חַד אֵ֭לַי אֵ֣יד אֵ֑ל וּ֝מִשְּׂאֵת֗וֹ לֹ֣א אוּכָֽל׃

controles.web: For calamity from God is a terror to me. Because his majesty, I can do nothing.
controles.kjv: For destruction from God was a terror to me, and by reason of his highness I could not endure.
controles.livre: Porque o castigo de Deus era um assombro para mim, e eu não teria poder contra sua majestade.

versos.hebraico: אִם־שַׂ֣מְתִּי זָהָ֣ב כִּסְלִ֑י וְ֝לַכֶּ֗תֶם אָמַ֥רְתִּי מִבְטַחִֽי׃

controles.web: “If I have made gold my hope, and have said to the fine gold, ‘You are my confidence;’
controles.kjv: If I have made gold my hope, or have said to the fine gold, Thou art my confidence;
controles.livre: Se eu pus no ouro minha esperança, ou disse ao ouro fino: Tu és minha confiança;

versos.hebraico: אִם־אֶ֭שְׂמַח כִּי־רַ֣ב חֵילִ֑י וְכִֽי־כַ֝בִּ֗יר מָצְאָ֥ה יָדִֽי׃

controles.web: If I have rejoiced because my wealth was great, and because my hand had gotten much;
controles.kjv: If I rejoiced because my wealth was great, and because mine hand had gotten much;
controles.livre: Se eu me alegrei de que minha riqueza era muita, e de que minha mão havia obtido muito;

versos.hebraico: אִם־אֶרְאֶ֣ה א֖וֹר כִּ֣י יָהֵ֑ל וְ֝יָרֵ֗חַ יָקָ֥ר הֹלֵֽךְ׃

controles.web: if I have seen the sun when it shined, or the moon moving in splendor,
controles.kjv: If I beheld the sun when it shined, or the moon walking in brightness;
controles.livre: Se olhei para o sol quando brilhava, e à lua quando estava bela,

versos.hebraico: וַיִּ֣פְתְּ בַּסֵּ֣תֶר לִבִּ֑י וַתִּשַּׁ֖ק יָדִ֣י לְפִֽי׃

controles.web: and my heart has been secretly enticed, and my hand threw a kiss from my mouth,
controles.kjv: And my heart hath been secretly enticed, or my mouth hath kissed my hand:
controles.livre: E meu coração se deixou enganar em segredo, e minha boca beijou minha mão,

versos.hebraico: גַּם־ה֭וּא עָוֺ֣ן פְּלִילִ֑י כִּֽי־כִחַ֖שְׁתִּי לָאֵ֣ל מִמָּֽעַל׃

controles.web: this also would be an iniquity to be punished by the judges; for I should have denied the God who is above.
controles.kjv: This also were an iniquity to be punished by the judge: for I should have denied the God that is above.
controles.livre: Isto também seria um delito a ser sentenciado por juiz; porque teria negado ao Deus de cima.

versos.hebraico: אִם־אֶ֭שְׂמַח בְּפִ֣יד מְשַׂנְאִ֑י וְ֝הִתְעֹרַ֗רְתִּי כִּֽי־מְצָ֥אוֹ רָֽע׃

controles.web: “If I have rejoiced at the destruction of him who hated me, or lifted up myself when evil found him;
controles.kjv: If I rejoiced at the destruction of him that hated me, or lifted up myself when evil found him:
controles.livre: Se eu me alegrei da desgraça daquele que me odiava, e me agradei quando o mal o encontrou,

versos.hebraico: וְלֹא־נָתַ֣תִּי לַחֲטֹ֣א חִכִּ֑י לִשְׁאֹ֖ל בְּאָלָ֣ה נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃

controles.web: (yes, I have not allowed my mouth to sin by asking his life with a curse);
controles.kjv: Neither have I suffered my mouth to sin by wishing a curse to his soul.
controles.livre: Sendo que nem deixei minha boca pecar, desejando sua morte com maldição,

versos.hebraico: אִם־לֹ֣א אָ֭מְרוּ מְתֵ֣י אָהֳלִ֑י מִֽי־יִתֵּ֥ן מִ֝בְּשָׂר֗וֹ לֹ֣א נִשְׂבָּֽע׃

controles.web: if the men of my tent have not said, ‘Who can find one who has not been filled with his meat?’
controles.kjv: If the men of my tabernacle said not, Oh that we had of his flesh! we cannot be satisfied.
controles.livre: Se a gente da minha casa nunca tivesse dito: Quem não se satisfez da carne dada por ele?

versos.hebraico: בַּ֭חוּץ לֹא־יָלִ֣ין גֵּ֑ר דְּ֝לָתַ֗י לָאֹ֥רַח אֶפְתָּֽח׃

controles.web: (the foreigner has not lodged in the street, but I have opened my doors to the traveler);
controles.kjv: The stranger did not lodge in the street: but I opened my doors to the traveller.
controles.livre: O estrangeiro não passava a noite na rua; eu abria minhas portas ao viajante.

versos.hebraico: אִם־כִּסִּ֣יתִי כְאָדָ֣ם פְּשָׁעָ֑י לִטְמ֖וֹן בְּחֻבִּ֣י עֲוֺֽנִי׃

controles.web: if like Adam I have covered my transgressions, by hiding my iniquity in my heart,
controles.kjv: If I covered my transgressions as Adam, by hiding mine iniquity in my bosom:
controles.livre: Se encobri minhas transgressões como as pessoas fazem ,  escondendo meu delito em meu seio;

versos.hebraico: כִּ֤י אֶֽעֱר֨וֹץ׀ הָ֘מ֤וֹן רַבָּ֗ה וּבוּז־מִשְׁפָּח֥וֹת יְחִתֵּ֑נִי וָ֝אֶדֹּ֗ם לֹא־אֵ֥צֵא פָֽתַח׃

controles.web: because I feared the great multitude, and the contempt of families terrified me, so that I kept silence, and didn’t go out of the door—
controles.kjv: Did I fear a great multitude, or did the contempt of families terrify me, that I kept silence, and went not out of the door?
controles.livre: Porque eu tinha medo da grande multidão, e o desprezo das famílias me atemorizou; então me calei, e não saí da porta:

versos.hebraico: מִ֤י יִתֶּן־לִ֨י׀ שֹׁ֘מֵ֤עַֽ לִ֗י הֶן־תָּ֭וִי שַׁדַּ֣י יַעֲנֵ֑נִי וְסֵ֥פֶר כָּ֝תַ֗ב אִ֣ישׁ רִיבִֽי׃

controles.web: oh that I had one to hear me! (behold, here is my signature, let the Almighty answer me); let the accuser write my indictment!
controles.kjv: Oh that one would hear me! behold, my desire is, that the Almighty would answer me, and that mine adversary had written a book.
controles.livre: Quem me dera se alguém me ouvisse! Eis que minha vontade é que o Todo-Poderoso me responda, e meu adversário escrevesse um relato da acusação.

versos.hebraico: אִם־לֹ֣א עַל־שִׁ֭כְמִי אֶשָּׂאֶ֑נּוּ אֶֽעֶנְדֶ֖נּוּ עֲטָר֣וֹת לִֽי׃

controles.web: Surely I would carry it on my shoulder; and I would bind it to me as a crown.
controles.kjv: Surely I would take it upon my shoulder, and bind it as a crown to me.
controles.livre: Certamente eu o carregaria sobre meu ombro, e o poria em mim como uma coroa.

versos.hebraico: מִסְפַּ֣ר צְ֭עָדַי אַגִּידֶ֑נּוּ כְּמוֹ־נָ֝גִ֗יד אֲקָרֲבֶֽנּוּ׃

controles.web: I would declare to him the number of my steps. as a prince would I go near to him.
controles.kjv: I would declare unto him the number of my steps; as a prince would I go near unto him.
controles.livre: Eu lhe diria o número de meus passos, e como um príncipe eu me chegaria a ele.

versos.hebraico: אִם־עָ֭לַי אַדְמָתִ֣י תִזְעָ֑ק וְ֝יַ֗חַד תְּלָמֶ֥יהָ יִבְכָּיֽוּן׃

controles.web: If my land cries out against me, and its furrows weep together;
controles.kjv: If my land cry against me, or that the furrows likewise thereof complain;
controles.livre: Se minha terra clamar contra mim, e seus sulcos juntamente chorarem;

versos.hebraico: אִם־כֹּ֭חָהּ אָכַ֣לְתִּי בְלִי־כָ֑סֶף וְנֶ֖פֶשׁ בְּעָלֶ֣יהָ הִפָּֽחְתִּי׃

controles.web: if I have eaten its fruits without money, or have caused its owners to lose their life,
controles.kjv: If I have eaten the fruits thereof without money, or have caused the owners thereof to lose their life:
controles.livre: Se comi seus frutos sem pagar dinheiro, ou fiz expirar a alma de seus donos;

versos.hebraico: תַּ֤חַת חִטָּ֨ה׀ יֵ֥צֵא ח֗וֹחַ וְתַֽחַת־שְׂעֹרָ֥ה בָאְשָׁ֑ה תַּ֝֗מּוּ דִּבְרֵ֥י אִיּֽוֹב׃פ

controles.web: let briers grow instead of wheat, and stinkweed instead of barley.”   The words of Job are ended.
controles.kjv: Let thistles grow instead of wheat, and cockle instead of barley. The words of Job are ended.
controles.livre: Em lugar de trigo que me produza cardos, e ervas daninhas no lugar da cevada. Aqui terminam as palavras de Jó.
